newsitem.title: ITALY: Italcementi approves zero coupon board.
newsitem.headline: Italcementi approves zero coupon board.

text.p: Italcementi said its board had approved the issue of a 600 billion lire five-year zero coupon bond, repayable in full at maturity, the company said in a statement.
The price of the issue, to be handled by Mediobanca, will be set shortly before the issue.

Interest, based on the difference between the amount repayable at maturity and the issue price, will be at an annual rate equivalent to the average yield of a basket of fixed rate state bonds with a residual life similar to the duration of the Italcementi bond.
The company would request that the bonds be admitted for continuous trading on the Milan bourse screen trading system. (( Milan newsroom +392-66102321 ))
